expected_error_contract: Unchanged production tests/oracle/oracle.ts + tests/support/gl-scale-contract.ts enforce one BUFFER_CREATE E_LIMIT for x64-gl-scale only, all other command errors zero; exactly ten recording-only pixel failures, one GL buffer OOM and recovery. No test bypass.

source_review.verdict: PASS within bounded source-review scope, no blocking defect found
source_review.execution_scope: No independent tests/builds/gates/benchmarks; source review and existing focused evidence only

focused.includes: native-calls, retirement, native-seh; actual Asyncify and JSPI
focused.reproducer: Prior merged accounting assertions failed four high full-width CALL target cases; 26 controls passed. Corrected focused suite passed 36/36; unchanged corrected source included in both full unit runs.

benchmark.method: 5 alternating A/B pairs + warmup; uninstrumented; shared machine
benchmark.acceptance: All five fixtures in both actual modes; every signed paired range includes zero. No supported regression beyond paired spread; no speedup or universal zero-overhead claim.

environment.matrix: Serial background runner, no deadlines/assertions/skips weakened

audit.checks: Complete workload/null errors/interp0/stubs[], actual suspension, ON/OFF and cross-mode traces, exact inherited browser skips, unavailable OFF counters, exact u64 strings, owner/process equality and per-present process/thread equality across engines, bounded ring, frame summaries, unchanged GL scale error contract.

cleanup.removed: Prepared benchmark wasm copies; temporary dev.19 worktree; I15-owned Zig cache; disposable per-mode browser HTML/artifacts after JSON capture. No shared cache/lock/ticket cleanup.
